beats.headline: Cirrus Logic jumps 3.75% on Apple program addition
beats.explanation: Cirrus Logic gained 3.75% to close at $148.69 on double its normal volume. Customer Apple announced the inclusion of Cirrus Logic in its American Manufacturing Program, part of plans to invest $400 million through 2030 to expand domestic supply chains. The move was company-specific, as customer Apple was up just 0.11% while supplier TSM dropped 6.22%.

beats.headline: Cirrus Logic rises 4.52% on industrial IC launch
beats.explanation: Cirrus Logic shares climbed 4.52% to $164.84 after unveiling a new portfolio of industrial imaging integrated circuits for high-precision scanning platforms. The rally also coincided with Stifel raising its price target on the stock from $163 to $175 with a Buy rating. The move was company-specific, occurring while customer Apple fell 1.14% and supplier TSM dropped 3.13%.

beats.headline: Cirrus Logic falls 4.85% amid chip sector softness
beats.explanation: Shares slipped 4.85% to close at $162.51. Broad semiconductor sentiment took a hit following reports that OpenAI missed internal targets, sparking fears over tech demand. The decline was shared with supplier TSM, which fell 3.12%, while customer Apple rose 1.16%.

beats.headline: Cirrus Logic drops 3.21% as tech overhang lingers
beats.explanation: Cirrus Logic fell an additional 3.21% to $157.29 on average volume. No new company-specific announcements were reported, though broader semiconductor demand concerns stemming from earlier reports weighed on the stock. The move was company-specific, as competitor Qualcomm rose 4.00% and supplier TSM gained 0.38%.

beats.headline: Cirrus Logic drops 4.86% in peer-shared pullback
beats.explanation: Shares dropped 4.86% to close at $146.50 on 1.1x 30-day average volume without any company-specific news. The slide was shared with competitor Qualcomm, which fell 7.57%, while customer Apple moved opposite, gaining 3.14%.

beats.headline: Cirrus Logic declines 6.25% following target cut
beats.explanation: Cirrus Logic declined 6.25% to $137.36 as KeyBanc maintained an Overweight rating but cut its price target from $200 to $190. Weakness was shared across the sector, with competitor Qualcomm sliding 3.20% and customer Apple declining 0.77%.

beats.headline: Cirrus Logic drops 4.27% despite energy R&D grant
beats.explanation: Cirrus Logic fell 4.27% to close at $133.53 despite announcing a research grant from Scottish Enterprise to develop smart energy technology. The pullback was shared across connected companies, with competitor Qualcomm dropping 2.57%, supplier TSM down 1.34%, and customer Apple shedding 1.30%.

beats.headline: Cirrus Logic drops 4.57% on target cuts and delays
beats.explanation: Despite posting record Q1 revenue of $460 million and beating earnings estimates, Cirrus Logic shares declined 4.57% to $123.51 on double normal volume. Commentary pointed to pricing pressure and delays in the PC segment, prompting price target reductions from KeyBanc, Stifel, and Barclays. The move was company-specific, as customer Apple, competitor Qualcomm, and supplier TSM all gained.

beats.headline: Cirrus Logic rebounds 3.66% near cycle lows
beats.explanation: Shares bounced 3.66% to $113.06 on elevated volume following a sharp multi-week decline. No positive company filings were reported, though commentary noted the stock was trading near cyclical lows while attempting to pivot into industrial and smart metering markets. The rebound was shared with competitor Qualcomm, which gained 2.01%.

beats.headline: Cirrus Logic rallies 5.20% alongside Apple
beats.explanation: Cirrus Logic climbed 5.20% to $116.48 on above-average trading volume. The surge coincided with strength in key customer Apple, which moved up 3.56% the same day, while competitor Qualcomm saw a modest gain of 0.27% and supplier TSM dropped 1.68%.

beats.headline: Cirrus Logic rises 5.05% in peer-shared advance
beats.explanation: The stock climbed 5.05% to $122.21 on 1.6x average volume, continuing a volatile recovery off its lows as analysts highlighted valuation and buyback support after a roughly 27% three-month drawdown. Competitor Qualcomm similarly rallied 4.25%, while customer Apple slipped 0.52%.

beats.headline: Cirrus Logic slips 3.44% amid macro pressure
beats.explanation: Cirrus Logic fell 3.44% to $118.00, giving back a portion of the previous session's surge. Broad market headwinds weighed on equities as 10-year Treasury yields breached 5% and oil prices topped $105. Competitor Qualcomm also fell 1.58%, though customer Apple managed a 0.32% gain.

arc: Cirrus Logic experienced a turbulent six-month trajectory, initially reaching highs above $170 in April before undergoing a protracted slide down toward $110 by late summer. The earlier gains were fueled by company-specific catalysts, notably its inclusion in Apple's American Manufacturing Program and product expansion into industrial imaging ICs. However, sentiment deteriorated sharply from late April through August due to emerging reports of demand headwinds, PC segment roll-out delays, and pricing pressure—which culminated in a series of price target reductions following its Q1 fiscal 2027 earnings release. By September, after losing over a quarter of its value from mid-year levels, the stock found dip-buying support around perceived valuation bottoms and share repurchase backing, though it continued to exhibit elevated volatility alongside macro pressures such as surging Treasury yields.
